provenance.method: Published rainfall aggregate disaggregated to an hourly series via the Alternating Block Method (Chow, Maidment & Mays, Applied Hydrology, 1988, S14.3), shaped by this project's own cited NE Himalaya intensity-duration curve (I = 5.8294*D^-0.4141) used only as a dimensionless depth-duration SHAPE, rescaled to the actually-published event total. See scripts/build_scenario.py's module docstring for the full method, including the antecedent_* and soil_moisture derivations. Clock window, rainfall total, quarry-collapse coordinates, NH-6/Hunthar severance, IMD warning, and death toll are BUILD_PLAN.md Appendix B's own worked example for this exact scenario, reused verbatim rather than re-derived.
sources: docs/reference/AI-Based Early Warning & Landslide Risk Monitoring System for the North Eastern Region.md S1 (case-study table)
provenance.disclaimer: Rainfall series is reconstructed from a published aggregate figure, not archived gauge observation. Per-cell spatial variation and soil_moisture are illustrative synthetic proxies for this project's current stub demo grid, not measured per-slope data. antecedent_7d/15d/30d reflect only the reconstructed event-window rainfall (zero-padded before it) and likely UNDERSTATE true pre-event background wetness, since no cited pre-event baseline exists in docs/reference/ for this event -- a documented limitation, not a fabricated number. cell_id values reuse the Phase 0 stub 3x3 demo-grid convention (aizawl_{row}{col}) -- see frontend/src/lib/grid.ts and CLAUDE.md's Current State. Real per-slope cell geometry exists in data/static/aizawl/cells.gpkg (2,912 cells) but is not yet wired into the live/replay pipeline, so this scenario's spatial resolution is illustrative, not the real analysis grid. insar_velocity_mm_yr is null throughout: this is a rainfall-triggered shallow failure, not a slow/deep-seated deformation case (CLAUDE.md rule 4).

road_events.consequence: Aizawl isolated from the rest of the country

outcome.deaths: 27-34 (state total; 33 bodies recovered per academic study)
outcome.source_note: Report as a range with source; do not assert a single figure.

narration.text: Antecedent rainfall from Cyclone Remal has been saturating Aizawl's slopes since the 26th; cumulative wetness is at its highest of the event as dawn approaches on the 28th.
Stone quarry collapse reported at Melthum-Hlimen (documented failure time).
NH-6 severed at Hunthar -- Aizawl isolated from the rest of the country.
